authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation and local read-only repository reconciliation
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded persisted appointments report through the Reports Workbench
authority.decision: Authorize only reversible scheduling-module/repository, ReportsService catalog/API/runtime seam, SPA Workbench and focused/disposable PostgreSQL verification changes for a tenant-scoped on-demand appointments report. Preserve the exact thirteen persisted fields, strict status/search/inclusive UTC date filters, deterministic scheduledAt/appointmentId order, 10,000-row bound, database-only source and audited execution/export. Exclude professional-care aggregation, local registry name joins, writes, queue/encounter semantics, worker scheduling, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill, legal retention and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing appointments schema/RLS, adding PII/name joins, changing status/date/search semantics, adding worker schedules or expanding into professional-care, queue, encounter, provider, target or production behavior.

next_action: Write and run the intentional scheduling source, report catalog/API and SPA RED tests, then implement the smallest bounded persisted report path and PostgreSQL proof.

Changes to ReportsService execution/export/audit or the authenticated report permission boundary
